summary: Updates the sound instance ID list of a sound-manager object. Guarded by a flag at this+0x13D8. When the flag is non-zero, first clears every existing instance (count at this+0x155C, array at this+0x1560) by calling the vtable method at *(this+0x1100)+0xB8 with flag 0, then writes the new instance count a2 and repopulates the array from a caller-supplied source, reading each ID from *(*(a3))+4 and calling the same vtable method with flag 1. Source entries are spaced 56 bytes apart. Returns the new instance count.

operations.description: Guard on the enabled flag at this+0x13D8; when zero the entire instance update is skipped and the function returns the flag value.
Guard on the existing instance count at this+0x155C being greater than zero; the clear pass only runs when it is.
Clear pass: iterate over the existing instance ID array starting at this+0x1560, bound by the current count at this+0x155C.
Call the vtable method at *(this+0x1100)+0xB8 with arguments (this+0x1100, instance ID, 0); flag 0 removes an existing instance. Each call result is stored into this+0x0.
Write the new instance count a2 into this+0x155C.
Guard on a2 being greater than zero; the repopulate pass only runs when it is.
Repopulate pass: iterate over the instance ID array starting at this+0x1560, a2 iterations.
Read each new instance ID as *(*(a3) + 4): dereference the source entry pointer and take the dword at +4.
Store the new instance ID into the current array slot at this+0x1560 and advance the slot pointer.
Call the vtable method at *(this+0x1100)+0xB8 with arguments (this+0x1100, new instance ID, 1); flag 1 adds/starts an instance. Each call result is stored into this+0x0.
Advance the source pointer by 56 bytes per entry (source entries are 56 bytes apart).
Return the new instance count stored in this+0x155C (equal to a2).
